data.name: Fairuzun
data.gender_notes: Fairuzun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Means 'jewel' or 'precious one'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'far' which means 'distant' and 'uzun' which means 'deep'. Together, it conveys the idea of a precious gem that is deeply valued. The name Fairuzun carries the meaning “Jewel, Precious One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fairuzun usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, precious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner beauty, grace, and elegance. It is a name for a child who is expected to grow up to be a gentle and refined individual.
data.etymology: Fairuzun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel, Precious One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fairuzun total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
